projects.title: Seatline: High-Concurrency Atomic Booking Engine
projects.desc:
• Engineered a high-concurrency booking engine using Node.js, Express.js, React.js, Socket.IO, and MongoDB to eliminate double-booking under heavy traffic.
• Implemented atomic database operations ($bit, findOneAndUpdate) to handle simultaneous seat reservation requests safely without race conditions.
• Built live real-time seat availability updates using Socket.IO for connected clients.
• Conducted stress/load testing simulating 20+ concurrent reservation requests on a single seat to empirically prove zero overselling.
